_source: Thrust (C64, Firebird 1986). Values read from code/RAM and verified in the tools/ harness; see re/report_physics.md

timing.overrun_rule: after waiting for $B479<0: $B479 += 3; if no carry (overrun >= 3 extra ticks) $B479 = 0. Overruns of 1-2 ticks are caught up next iteration, larger ones are dropped.
timing.rotation_iterations: iteration counter $19: rotate when ($19 & 3) != 0 (3 of 4 iterations)
timing.physics_ticks_note: velocity update (gravity, thrust, drag, fuel burn) only when ($19 & 15) in this list (6 of 16 iterations)

units.x: 24-bit $09:$08:$07, integer part = X unit = 4 hires pixels (2 multicolour pixels), 16 fraction bits
units.y: 24-bit $0C:$0B:$0A, integer part = Y unit = 2 raster lines, 8 fraction bits
units.vx: 24-bit signed $14:$13:$12, same scaling as x (per main-loop iteration)
units.vy: 16-bit signed $16:$15, same scaling as y (per main-loop iteration); sign-extended when added
units.rod_angle: 24-bit $1D:$1C:$1B, $1D = 0..31 angle steps (masked & 31), 0 = ship directly above pod

gravity.units: added to vy (1/256 Y unit) on each physics tick
gravity.reverse: when $A6A5 != 0: gravity = ~g as 16-bit ($FF:~g) = -(g+1); start angle 16 instead of 0; respawn-with-pod rod angle $11 instead of 1

drag.vx: vx -= vx >> 6 (arithmetic, 24-bit) on every physics tick
drag.vy: vy -= vy >> 8 (arithmetic, 16-bit) on every physics tick

pod_rod.ship_offset_from_centre: ox = interp(TX, rod+8)/4, oy = interp(TY, rod+8)/4 (1/256 units) -> radius 5 X units (20 px) and 10 Y units (20 lines)
pod_rod.torque: if thrust and tick in torque_ticks: av += interp(TX, (ang<<8) - (rod>>8) + 8) >> 1;  av -= (av_old >> 6) + 1
pod_rod.rod_integration: rod += av every iteration when pod attached or ship dead
pod_rod.attach_distance_metric: d = min(|dx|,|dy|) + 3*max(|dx|,|dy|) (8-bit, saturating at 255) between ship sprite ($4E,$50) and pod sprite ($51,$53) coordinates, X low byte only
pod_rod.attach: centre = midpoint(ship, pod); vx,vy halved; rod angle from 7-level 3-point search; av = (vy16*dxPx - vx16*dyLines) >> 2 into $20:$1F

fuel.thrust_cost: 1 per physics tick while thrusting (6/16 iterations = ~12.2/s)
fuel.shield_cost: 1 per iteration in which the shield sprite is shown ($28=1: SPACE held and IRQ frame counter $1A bit1 set, ~50% of iterations, ~16/s)
fuel.refuel_zone: fuel cell object (type 4), SPACE held, pod not attached, alive: 1 <= cellX - shipX <= 5 (X units), 0 <= cellY - shipY <= 27 (Y units); ship = draw position $33/$30:$2F
fuel.empty: when a burn finds fuel == 0: $57=$FF (no more thrust/shield), $9402=$FF (game over at end of this life or on leaving the planet)

bullets.slots: particle slots 0-3 used as a ring ($2D)
bullets.velocity: vx = TX[ang]/256 X units/it (8.8), vy = TY[ang]/256 Y units/it (8.8) + ship draw-position delta of last iteration
bullets.spawn: ship draw pos + (4 X units, 5 Y units), then advanced 2 steps immediately (+1 normal step in the same iteration)
bullets.fire: RETURN (index $01); edge triggered (needs release); not while SPACE held; blocked while the next ring slot still holds a live bullet
bullets.pixel: 1 multicolour pixel x 2 lines, bit pattern %10 (colour from screen RAM low nibble)

death.rod_shrink: $54 -= 2 per iteration while dead; when < 0 the other body explodes (ship after pod crash / pod after ship crash), restarting the 60 countdown
collision_sources: $D01F bit7: ship sprite vs bitmap (terrain, bullets, %10/%11 pixels)
$D01E bit7: ship sprite vs any sprite (objects)
$D01F bit6: pod sprite vs bitmap (ignored while centre Y in $100..$177)
enemy bullet particle (type 3) in ship box unless SPACE held
